article.headline: Ivery scores 21 off the bench, North Carolina A&T knocks off Cheyney (PA) 104-76
article.description: — Brandon Ivery scored 21 points off of the bench to lead North Carolina A&T over Cheyney (Pennsylvania) 104-76 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Ivery scores 21 off the bench, North Carolina A&T knocks off Cheyney (PA) 104-76

article.story: GREENSBORO, N.C. -- — Brandon Ivery scored 21 points off of the bench to lead North Carolina A&T over Cheyney (Pennsylvania) 104-76 on Saturday. Ivery shot 6 for 11 (2 for 7 from 3-point range) and 7 of 8 from the free-throw line for the Aggies (2-2). Saxton Simley added 19 points while going 6 of 11 from the floor, including 3 for 5 from 3-point range, and 4 for 5 from the line while he also had seven rebounds. Shane Lancaster went 6 of 7 from the field (3 for 3 from 3-point range) to finish with 15 points. S.J. Hutchinson II led the Wolves in scoring, finishing with 19 points. Amare Curtis added 13 points and four assists for Cheyney. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
